name: rockstarr-content
description: Rockstarr AI content plugin. Drafts researched blogs, thought-leadership, email and LinkedIn newsletters, case studies, and repurposed short-form in the client's approved voice, plus the SEO layer: keyword and cluster strategy and an impact-first site audit that feeds the content backlog.
